test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a state-of-the-art infrastructure, disaster-resilient facility launched by the Government of India in June 2025 for strengthening disaster preparedness and response mechanisms?

options.text: Advanced Disaster Response and Monitoring Facility
Integrated Control Room for Emergency Response

solution:
The correct answer is __**Integrated Control Room for Emergency Response**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Integrated Control Room for Emergency Response (ICR-ER)** is a state-of-the-art facility launched by the **Government of India** in **June 2025** to enhance disaster preparedness and response mechanisms.
 
• This facility is designed to provide **real-time monitoring** and **centralized coordination** during disasters, ensuring efficient communication between various stakeholders.
 
• It integrates advanced technologies such as **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, **Geospatial Analysis**, and **Internet of Things (IoT)** to predict, monitor, and respond to emergencies effectively.
 
• The ICR-ER serves as a **centralized hub** for managing resources, evacuations, and relief efforts during disasters like earthquakes, floods, cyclones, and other emergencies.
 
• This initiative aligns with India's commitment to the **Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction (2015–2030)**, focusing on minimizing disaster impact through preparedness and technological advancements.
 
• It operates under the supervision of the **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)**, ensuring seamless integration with national and state-level disaster management agencies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Disaster Resilience in India:**

 
 
• India is prone to various natural disasters such as **earthquakes, floods, cyclones, and droughts**, impacting millions annually.
 
• The **Disaster Management Act, 2005** provides the legal framework for disaster risk reduction and response mechanisms in India.
 
• The **NDMA** oversees disaster management policies and coordinates efforts between the **central and state governments**.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Integrated Control Room for Emergency Response:**
 
 
• Equipped with **real-time data analytics** for early warning systems.
 
• Facilitates **inter-agency communication** and collaboration during emergencies.
 
• Includes **GIS mapping** for locating affected areas and prioritizing relief efforts.
 
• Ensures availability of **emergency response resources** such as medical supplies, evacuation plans, and shelters.
 
 
 
• **Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction:**
 
 
• Adopted in **2015**, this global framework emphasizes reducing disaster risks and enhancing resilience.
 
• It focuses on **prevention, preparedness, and recovery** to mitigate the impact of disasters.
 
• India aligns its disaster management strategies with the **Sendai Framework** to ensure global best practices.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Initiatives:**
 
 
• **Centralized Crisis Management Centre:** Focuses on crisis response but lacks the advanced technological integration seen in ICR-ER.
 
• **Advanced Disaster Response and Monitoring Facility:** Primarily a monitoring initiative without centralized emergency control capabilities.
 
• **National Disaster Coordination Hub:** Coordinates disaster management efforts but does not include the real-time technological features of the ICR-ER.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Technological Integration in Disaster Management:**

 
 
• Technologies like **AI** and **IoT** enable predictive analysis and proactive measures during disasters.
 
• Use of **satellite imagery** and **drones** enhances surveillance and resource allocation.
 
• Advanced communication systems ensure uninterrupted connectivity during emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Global Examples of Emergency Response Systems:**
 
 
• The United States operates the **Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA)** for disaster response and recovery.
 
• Japan's **Disaster Medical Assistance Teams (DMATs)** focus on medical relief during emergencies.
 
• India's ICR-ER is among the few global initiatives integrating advanced technologies for disaster resilience.
